name: iPlayGFN
subtitle: GeForce NOW for iPhone
description: A native GeForce NOW player for iPhone and iPad. Releases are published automatically from github.com/reefbarman/iPlayGFN.

apps.name: iPlayGFN
apps.subtitle: Play your GeForce NOW games natively
apps.localizedDescription:
Play with on-screen virtual controls or a supported controller such as an Xbox controller, DualSense or Backbone. By default, virtual controls stay out of the way while a controller is connected.

Sign in to GeForce NOW and stream the games you own with native NVST streaming, hardware HEVC/H.264 decoding and Metal. Up to 4K, 120 fps and HDR where your membership allows, per-game video settings, gyro aiming and rumble. Tuned for the iPhone Duo's inner screen, and works on any iPhone or iPad running iOS 17 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: See the release notes on GitHub.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: iPlayGFN uses a local address to finish signing in to GeForce NOW.
